u0: The shop is in a clean state with no active commitment: no siren needs silencing, no arrived client is waiting for an order, no taken order is waiting for preparation or service, and no fallen food needs recovery. There is no terminal success state; the job is to keep responding to the recurring siren and client events, taking each order, fetching and preparing food, and serving it. A delivery must never be made while the siren is already ringing.
u1: The siren is ringing and has not yet been silenced, so the outstanding job is to reach the switch and turn it off. No other specific obligation is pending in this state. Once the siren is off, resume handling any clients or food tasks; never serve while the siren is already ringing.
u10: Food has just fallen, an order is waiting to be prepared, and the siren is ringing. The next step must be the immediate pickup of the fallen food, or the task fails permanently. After recovering it, prepare the order, silence the siren before any service, and complete the delivery.
u11: Prepared food has fallen and must be picked up on the very next step; missing that deadline is irreversible failure. The recovered food is still the prepared portion that must be given to the waiting client. No siren response is pending now, but any new ring must be silenced before service.
u12: Prepared food has fallen and must be recovered on the next step, while the siren is also ringing. Recover the food immediately to avoid permanent failure, then turn off the siren before delivering that prepared food to the waiting client. Serving while the siren is already ringing is forbidden.
u13: A client has arrived and is waiting for their order to be taken. Take the order at the counter; afterward the food must be fetched, prepared, and served. No siren response is pending, but if the siren starts, it must be off before delivery.
u14: A client has arrived and still needs their order taken, and the siren is ringing. Both obligations are outstanding: take the client's order and turn off the siren. The order can be handled while the siren rings, but the food must not be served until the siren is silent.
u15: A client arrival still needs its order taken, and prepared food is also awaiting delivery. Both obligations remain: take the client's order and make sure the prepared food is served. Any service must wait until the siren is silent.
u16: A client has arrived and still needs their order taken, prepared food is awaiting delivery, and the siren is ringing. The siren must be silenced before any service, and the client's order must also be taken. Then complete the pending delivery without serving while the siren is ringing.
u17: A client has arrived without their order being taken, and food has just slipped from the hands. The next step must recover the fallen food immediately, or the task fails permanently. After that, take the client's order, prepare their food, and serve it.
u18: A client has arrived without an order taken, food has just fallen, and the siren is ringing. The next step must pick up the fallen food; failing to do so fails the task permanently. After recovery, take the client's order, silence the siren before service, and complete preparation and delivery.
u19: A client arrival still needs its order taken, prepared food is awaiting service, and food has just fallen. The next step must recover the fallen food, or the task fails permanently. After recovery, take the client's order and serve the prepared food, with any siren silenced before delivery.
u2: A mandatory requirement has been broken for good: an order was served while the siren was already ringing, or fallen food was not recovered on the following step. The failure is irreversible, so successful completion is no longer possible.
u20: The siren is ringing, a client is waiting to have their order taken, and prepared food still needs to be served to a client. Food has just slipped from the agent's hands and must be picked up on the very next step to avoid breaking a requirement. The siren must be switched off before the prepared food is served.
u21: A client's order has already been taken but its food has not yet been prepared, and a client is waiting to have their order taken. The taken order needs food fetched from the pantry as needed and prepared at the stove, while the waiting client's order must still be taken. Further clients and rings can add new obligations as the shop continues.
u22: A taken order still needs its food fetched and prepared, and a client is waiting to have their order taken. The siren is ringing and must be switched off. Serving must not happen while the siren is ringing.
u23: Food has just slipped and must be picked up on the very next step to avoid failing the requirement. A taken order still needs its food fetched and prepared, and a client is waiting to have their order taken.
u24: Food has just slipped and must be recovered on the very next step. A taken order still needs food fetched and prepared, a client is waiting to have their order taken, and the siren is ringing. The siren must be switched off before any later serving.
u25: Prepared food still needs to be served to a client, and a taken order still needs its food fetched and prepared. If the siren starts ringing before the prepared dish is served, it must be switched off first because serving during a ring is forbidden.
u26: Prepared food still needs to be served, a taken order still needs its food fetched and prepared, and the siren is ringing. The siren must be switched off before the prepared food is served.
u27: Food has just slipped and must be picked up on the very next step. Prepared food still needs to be served, and a taken order still needs its food fetched and prepared.
u28: Food has just slipped and must be recovered on the very next step. Prepared food still needs to be served, a taken order still needs its food fetched and prepared, and the siren is ringing. The siren must be switched off before serving the prepared food.
u29: Prepared food still needs to be served, a taken order still needs its food fetched and prepared, and a client is waiting to have their order taken. If the siren starts ringing before the prepared dish is served, it must be switched off first.
u3: An order has been taken and is waiting for its food to be prepared. If the agent is not already carrying food, it must fetch a portion from the pantry, then prepare it at the stove for the waiting client. After preparation, the food must be served, and any service must wait until the siren is silent.
u30: Prepared food still needs to be served, a taken order still needs its food fetched and prepared, a client is waiting to have their order taken, and the siren is ringing. The siren must be switched off before the prepared food is served.
u31: Food has just slipped and must be picked up on the very next step. Prepared food still needs to be served, a taken order still needs its food fetched and prepared, and a client is waiting to have their order taken.
u32: Food has just slipped and must be back in hand on the very next step. The siren is ringing, prepared food still needs to be served, a taken order still needs its food fetched and prepared, and a client is waiting to have their order taken. The siren must be switched off before the prepared food is served.
u4: An order has been taken and still needs preparation, and the siren is also ringing. The agent can work toward fetching and preparing the food, but must turn the siren off before serving; serving while it is ringing permanently fails the task. Both the siren response and the order's preparation and service remain outstanding.
u5: A portion of prepared food is ready and a client who has ordered is waiting; the remaining job is to serve it at the counter. No siren response is currently pending, so delivery can proceed while the room is quiet. If a new ring begins before service, turn it off before handing over the food.
u6: Prepared food is ready for a waiting client, but the siren is ringing. Turn off the siren and only then serve the food; serving while the siren is already ringing would irreversibly fail the task. Both silencing the siren and completing the delivery are outstanding.
u7: The carried food has just slipped from the agent's hands and must be picked up on the very next step. That immediate recovery is the only specific obligation pending here; missing the one-step deadline permanently fails the task.
u8: Food has just fallen and must be picked up on the very next step; failing to recover it immediately permanently fails the task. At the same time, the siren is ringing and must be silenced. The next step must be the pickup, after which the switch can be handled; no order may be served while the siren is ringing.
u9: Food has just fallen while an order is already waiting to be prepared. The very next step must restore food to the hands by picking it up, or the task fails permanently. After recovery, prepare the ordered food at the stove and then serve it, making sure the siren is silent during delivery.
